note: Healing data from the dense teacher, in shards (written 2026-11-05, before any shard is generated). The user's goal: the student should beat dense models with as many parameters as its active ones (Qwen3.5-2B/4B-class), on quality rather than on matching the 9B; the sampler handles loops. Plan the user approved: the dense 9B writes answers in vLLM (vllm_proof_rules.json showed its log-probs match our HF teacher to 0.0075 nats), wrong answers are dropped, short correct answers are preferred by a random length rule, and the student heals on them in time-boxed local and pod sessions (heal_sessions.py). The user, on this step: 'do it'.

teacher.model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B at run_slim_pod.MODEL's pinned revision, bf16
teacher.vllm: 0.33.0, in its own environment, with VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 (the image has no nvcc); LLM(dtype bfloat16, max_model_len 8192, logprobs_mode raw_logprobs, max_logprobs 20, generation_config 'vllm', no images or video)
teacher.grader: math-verify==0.9.0, installed in the vLLM environment

gsm8k.grader: number: the last number after any </think>, a boxed one first (slim_batch.final_number, as the GSM8K check scores), equal to the gold within 1e-6

math.dataset: EleutherAI/hendrycks_math, all seven configs, train (7,500 rows); gold is the solution's last \boxed{}, rows without one are skipped

openthoughts.dataset: open-thoughts/OpenThoughts-114k metadata, rows 0 to 7,999: domain math whose ground_truth_solution has a \boxed{} of at most 80 characters; no proofs (questions saying prove, show that or demonstrate, or boxed Q.E.D. or a square)

chat.dataset: HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k train_sft rows 0 to 4,999: the first user message, 20 to 1,500 characters
chat.grader: none (correct is null; kept if finished)

exclude: Items the benchmark corpus holds as eval documents (same idents as its domains: gsm8k-<row>, <config>-<row>, openthoughts-<row>). The GSM8K check prompts are GSM8K test rows, MATH-500 is MATH test: no overlap with train splits.

shards.problems: Each source's eligible rows in an order fixed by the seed, dealt to shards in turn (shard s takes the s-th block of per_shard rows of each source); within a shard the problems are shuffled by the seed so any prefix is mixed.
shards.folder: heal_shards/problems_<shard>.jsonl (bundled); generated shards land in results/heal-shards-pod-<date>/<job>/shards/shard_<nnn>/ and are moved into the pool folder of heal_sessions_rules.json
shards.format: samples.jsonl (one row per answer: id, sample, source, thinking, chunk, prompt_ids, answer_ids ending with the stop token when finished, finished, finish_reason, correct, gold, extracted, logprob_sum) and teacher_<chunk>.npz (ids_<row> int32 and logprobs_<row> float16, (len(answer_ids), 20), for finished answers only: the teacher's raw top-20 at each answer token, the stop token included)
shards.time_box: A chunk starts only if the last chunk's duration times 1.1 (40 minutes for the first) still fits before the worker's deadline less 10 minutes; a cut shard is still a valid shard.
shards.changed_after_shard_0: 2026-11-06: problems_001..003 rewritten with math on 1 and openthoughts on 0 (outcome_shard_0.lesson); the problems themselves are unchanged.

budget: Shard 0: a $5 cap (runpod_budget_heal_shard0_20261105.json), one 48 GB card at most $0.60/h, 3.5-hour deadline.

predictions.throughput: 1,250 to 1,500 generated tokens per second over the generation (vllm_proof: 1,383 with the same settings, smaller batches); shard 0 finishes its 2,000 problems inside the deadline.
predictions.tokens: 8 to 13 million generated tokens for shard 0.
predictions.kept: Answers correct and finished, by source and thinking mode: gsm8k off 85-95%, on 80-92%; math off 55-75%, on 50-70%; openthoughts off 25-50%, on 15-40%; chat off 95%+ finished, on 75%+ finished.
predictions.teacher_rows: The sampled token is in the stored top-20 at 99% or more of answer positions; the stop token's position is stored for every finished answer.
